trigger: A product requirement document must be written or revised ('write a PRD', 'เขียน PRD', a brief with a prototype or reference site)
inputs: the user's brief and answers to the brief questions
every prototype, reference site, product, or dataset the user names
an earlier PRD.md version when revising
action: Ask only the brief questions sources cannot answer, read the references, write PRD.md in the 18-section template with evidence labels and linked IDs, check it with prd-check.mjs, render prd.html, and stop for review

outputs.description: PRD.md with the 18 sections and a Changelog, and prd.html rendered from it
the open questions that change scope or an ADR, asked together, with who must answer each
the PRD version, its checker result, the assumptions awaiting review, and the remaining open questions

handoff.when: the PRD is approved and must become a decision sheet and task backlog
the product direction itself is still undecided
a business rule, money, personal-data, or scope choice needs a decision

aiDoes: reads the named references and records what they show as evidence
writes PRD.md, checks it, and renders prd.html
labels every unsourced target, rule, and persona detail as an assumption
humanDoes: supplies the brief, real data, and the reviewers for each round
humanDecides: scope, business rules, and every ADR
